verdict.rationale: The evidence only shows that Lago lets customers upgrade or downgrade at any moment. Nothing in the pack documents proration math, credits for unused time, partial-period calculations, or reconciling invoice line items, which are the core of this story. Plan-change flexibility is an adjacent capability and does not demonstrate auditable proration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, mid-cycle upgrades and downgrades are prorated with documented, auditable math — credits, partial periods, and invoice line items that reconcile to the penny
